children: CEA Industries Inc. reported results for the 2026 quarter, with revenue rising to $7.17M from $4.58M a year earlier, while the company recorded a net loss of ($11.4M) and diluted EPS of ($0.22).
¹ Reported as “Revenue”. ² Reported as “Net loss”. ³ Reported as “Net income (loss) per share of common stock attributable to common shareholders”.
BNB Treasury Focus: The company’s DAT strategy concentrates treasury holdings on 515,544 BNB, aligning operations with participation in the BNB ecosystem.
Revenue mix shift: Retail operations under the Fat Panda brand remain the primary source of operating revenue; industrial systems sales are immaterial compared with vape retail.
Retail footprint and operations: Fat Panda operates 34 stores plus e-commerce and in-house e‑liquid manufacturing, supporting retail momentum following the acquisition and integration.
Airdrop and yield decline: Airdrop and Launchpool yields have materially declined, reducing non-cash treasury income and lowering expected yield from treasury holdings.
Operational milestones: The company launched DAT after a PIPE, completed the Fat Panda acquisition and integrated retail operations under new governance.
